items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Delivers the approved proposal: per-finding cards for high/critical, machine-resolved items re-raisable, GHAS-independent artifact path, scan-driven freshness. CI-side writing step deliberately replaced by scan-run-id trigger (no new CI write permission).

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Freshness probe fails soft to the throttle; cards fail-soft per append like other units; missing location yields path 'unknown'.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Scanner-supplied rule/path reduced to [A-Za-z0-9._/@:+-], capped at 120; no finding descriptions on cards.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 7 new tests, 2 verified red without the triage.py fix; 7 pre-existing expectations updated for the new card units.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One extra gh api call at session start only when the throttle has not expired.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New module finding_units.py; consumer.py held at 300 LOC; triage.py net 0 lines.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Boundary: github_import_state.json (backward compatible, extra optional key) and triage dedup contract (dismissed machine-resolved no longer durable).
